name: Cisco ASA — Outbound SMTP Spam Bot Activity
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter (cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "302013" or cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "302014")
       and xdm.source.port in (25, 587)
       and xdm.target.interface = "inside"
| bin _time span = 15m
| comp count_distinct(xdm.source.ipv4) as distinct_mx,
       values(xdm.source.ipv4) as source_mx,
       values(xdm.source.port) as source_ports
       by xdm.target.ipv4, _time
| filter distinct_mx >= 34
| fields xdm.target.ipv4, source_mx, source_ports
description: Internal host fanning out SMTP connections to many distinct external mail destinations — spam-bot indicator.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — Outbound SMTP Spam Bot Activity
